map.铸件凝固时间计算（模数法/Chvorinov 法则），依据铸件模数与凝固系数估算: Casting solidification time calculation (modulus method / Chvorinov rule), estimating the time to full solidification from the casting modulus and solidification coefficient.

map.模数越大，凝固越慢；冒口模数应大于铸件模数以保证补缩。: The larger the modulus, the slower the solidification; the riser modulus should exceed the casting modulus to ensure feeding.
map.铸造工艺设计时按 Chvorinov 法则估算铸件在铸型中的凝固时间，据此确定开: In casting process design, estimate the solidification time of a casting in the mould by the Chvorinov rule, and use it to set the shakeout time and the riser feeding window.
map.比较不同材质/铸型组合的凝固系数，判断同一铸件在砂型或金属型中的冷却快慢差异。: Compare the solidification coefficients of different material and mould combinations to judge how much faster the same casting cools in a sand mould versus a metal mould.
map.按模数相对大小快速排序多个铸件或同一铸件不同壁厚的凝固先后，指导冷铁与冒口布置。: Rank the solidification sequence of several castings, or of different wall thicknesses in one casting, by relative modulus, guiding the placement of chills and risers.
map.凝固时间 t = K × (V/A)² = K × M²，其中 M = V/A: Solidification time t = K × (V/A)² = K × M², where M = V/A is the casting modulus (volume to heat dissipation area ratio) and K is the solidification coefficient. Common coefficients (by mould and material): sand mould cast iron 0.094, sand mould cast steel 0.116, sand mould cast aluminium 0.170, metal mould cast iron 0.030, metal mould cast aluminium 0.015. Units follow the tool's built-in calibration.
map.边长 10 cm 与 20 cm 两个立方铸件，模数分别为 10/6=1.667: For two cube castings of 10 cm and 20 cm side, the moduli are 10/6=1.667 cm and 20/6=3.333 cm; the solidification time ratio = (M₂/M₁)² = (3.333/1.667)² = 4, so the larger casting takes about 4 times as long to solidify. Doubling wall thickness doubles the modulus and makes solidification about 4 times longer, which is the key basis for riser and chill design.
map.为什么模数大的部位后凝固？: Why do high-modulus regions solidify last?
map.模数 M=V/A 越大，单位体积对应的散热表面积越小、散热越慢，凝固越晚，因此最: The larger the modulus M=V/A, the smaller the heat dissipation surface per unit volume, so cooling is slower and solidification happens later. Shrinkage cavities therefore form where solidification finishes last, requiring risers there for feeding.
map.砂型和金属型系数差很多说明什么？: What do the large differences between sand and metal mould coefficients mean?
map.金属型导热远快于砂型，故同一铸件在金属型中 K 小、凝固时间短；系数只是经验标定: Metal moulds conduct heat far faster than sand, so K is smaller and solidification faster for the same casting. The coefficients are only empirical calibrations; actual results also depend on thermal parameters and chill effect, so precise scheduling should follow measurements.
